condo: Lakeville Penthouse (Lake Views, beside MRT & Intl School)

history.summary: JLD penthouse (Lakeville, TOP 2017/2018, Lakeside MRT) at $1,317 psf, genuinely below the project's ~$1,776 psf average even allowing for a penthouse discount, with a real, dated Jurong Lake District catalyst (Jurong Region Line 2029, Cross Island Line Phase 2 2032, largest business district outside the central area). The drag is the asset type: a 2,278 sqft penthouse at a $3.0M absolute quantum is a thin, slow-to-exit segment, and the headline -30.9% age-adjusted cheapness is inflated by comparing a penthouse PSF against the project-pooled median.
history.rating_rationale: Value signal is the strongest of the cohort on paper (age_adj -30.9%, $1,317 psf vs Lakeville recent average ~$1,776 psf), and D05/OCR is the favoured forward region (~+4% realized) with a concrete infrastructure catalyst, not a portal-headline CAGR (appreciation_pct 3.7% is only a regional_baseline with 0 txns, so it carries no forward weight). But penthouses structurally trade below the project median PSF, so a large slice of the -30.9% is a measurement artefact rather than a true bargain (psf_cohort_txns is null — no penthouse comparables verified). At a $3.0M quantum in a leasehold OCR district, exit liquidity for a 2,278 sqft unit is weak over a 5-7yr hold, which offsets the genuine catalyst. Net Neutral: real location upside but unfavourable asset type and an over-stated cheapness number.
red_flags: Penthouse PSF (1,317) compared to project-pooled median overstates the -30.9% age-adjusted bargain; no same-size cohort comparables (psf_cohort_txns null)
$3.0M quantum + 2,278 sqft = thin penthouse resale segment, weak exit liquidity over a 5-7yr hold
appreciation_pct 3.7% is regional_baseline with 0 transactions — no project-level forward evidence
99-yr leasehold (TOP ~2017), lease decay over hold period
Listing-title cheapness ('Huge Size') is exactly the oversized-unit feature that flips to a flag for an investment hold
catalysts: Jurong Lake District: largest business district outside central area, 100k jobs / 20k homes by 2040-2050
Jurong Region Line (~2029) and Cross Island Line Phase 2 (~2032) adding two MRT lines to JLD
5-min walk to Lakeside MRT and adjacency to Jurong Lake Gardens / international school supports tenant demand
Asking PSF below Lakeville's project average leaves headroom if penthouse discount narrows
